full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that the appellants as plaintiffs instituted Other Class Suit. No. 100 of 1969 in the Court of learned Senior Munsif (now Senior Assistant Judge), Jamalpur for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of .27 V2 acme of land forming the western part of .55 acre of land appertaining to C.S. Plot No.237 of C.S. 1Chatian No.32 of Mouza-Char Roy locally known as Rayerchar of Police Station-Sadar and District-Jamalpur stating, inter alia, that the suit land belonged to one Adu Mona and after his death it devolved upon his heirs namely Sarabdi Molia, Dabaru Molla and others and the same was recorded in their names and suit plot No.237 was in the saham of aforesaid Sarabdii Molla and his brother Dabariu. Molla. Sarabdi Molia died leaving behind three sons namely Gahar Mona, Mahar Molia, Sayed Molla and a daughter who died without issue. Dabaru Molia died leaving behind son jaminuddin and two daughters. Gahar Mona died leaving behind two sons Hasen Ali, Kazim and two daughters Kuslom, Batashi. The heirs of Hagen Ali Molla and others sold the suit land to aforesaid jaminuddin and others who thereafter sold the property to the plaintiffs on 20.31.1957 and the plaintiffs gave the said land in barga to the predecessor of the defendants. Further case of the plaintiffs was that their claimed land of C.S. Plot N .737 was recorded in new plot Nos.673 and 674 and they were in possession of .27 acre in Plot No.67/1 and defendant No.1 dispossessed them from the suit land and hence, they had instituted the suit.
